description: BTA Column Chart is a modern, fully-featured column chart for Microsoft Power BI, rebuilt on Apache ECharts for crisp rendering and smooth interaction. Highlights: • Grouped, stacked, and 100% stacked column modes • Hierarchical category axis with per-level label formatting • Data labels and stack-total labels, with display-unit and decimal controls • Rich, customizable tooltips — including extra measures from the Tooltips well • Per-series and per-category color controls • Configurable legend, gridlines, value axis, and an analytics constant line • Built-in scrollbar for large category sets • Native Power BI integration: cross-filtering, multi-select, context menus, bookmarks, and high-contrast mode The visual renders entirely within the Power BI sandbox and makes no external network calls — your data never leaves your report. BTA Column Chart is part of the BTA Charts suite by Beyond the Analytics.
